# SHEKINAIH SIEW SIN YAP - J AARON K DAVID

> Heaven Throne Room Ministry, the official platform of SHEKINAIH SIEW SIN YAP and J AARON K DAVID: faith, legacy and global impact through Crowned Eagles Global, with their international events, awards and magazine cover stories, 2025-2026. From October 2026 the site refers to them as PROF. (HON.) DR. SHEKINAIH SIEW SIN YAP and DR. J AARON K DAVID.

SHEKINAIH SIEW SIN YAP is Founder & Managing Partner of Crowned Eagles Global LLP and CE Global Network LLP. J AARON K DAVID is Co-Founder & Partner of Crowned Eagles Global & CE Global Network LLP. Together they lead Crowned Eagles Global from Singapore. Contact: ceg@crownedeaglesglobal.org

## About

- [About Us](https://shekinaihsiewsinyap-jaaronkdavid.com/about.html): biographies, roles, Crowned Eagles Global and the key milestones of 2025–2026
- [In the Press](https://shekinaihsiewsinyap-jaaronkdavid.com/press.html): magazine cover stories, news coverage and announcements from publishers and award organisers
